mandatory_rules.rule: Use one private shared MAC/header/time verification core and one actual fresh-AuthDB nonce transaction. Legacy authenticate still returns Credential and preserves format1 behavior. No principal/SQL callback supplied by a client.

A valid MAC after active key/time/nonce checks consumes its fresh nonce with denial audit for bad business JSON, role/grant/scope refusal or logical-CID conflict. Invalid MAC/headers do not consume; inactive key/time/replay/nonce quota refusal does not consume a new nonce. Clock/store/audit inability yields 503 UNKNOWN and no success handle.

Fresh recognized auth format only, exact MAIN schema and constraints/foreign keys/immutable guards. Persist key identity-bound nonsecret role/account/validity and immutable grant identities/epochs. Old format1 authorities are not upgraded or repaired; old format1 behavior remains positive and old reader refuses new format.

Actual accepted audit sequence, profile revision, grant identity/epoch and authority are read/written in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as nonce, accepted receipt and immutable business reservation. Receipt is issued only after actual successful COMMIT return; recorded check time is not physical COMMIT time.

The logical business key excludes kind, payload hash and epoch. First acceptance/credential/grant binding never changes. A new nonce with same business content may obtain only an explicitly passive/query receipt pointing to original acceptance; it never mints a replacement execution capability. Changed kind/payload is 409. New grant cannot revive a revoked original CID.

H0 must provide a current-authorized AuthDB original-CID lookup for reply loss, requiring effective same-account credit.read permission. Foreign/revoked/forked/thread-moved/copied/JSON handles deny. Exported evidence cannot be imported as authority. All H0 handles are financial_authorized=false; no financial source, inbox, dispatch or listener exists.

Nonce expiry cannot delete accepted receipts or unresolved business reservations. Exact capacities and rejection precedence are explicit. New CID at reservation capacity fails closed; an existing reservation is never evicted or counted twice. No claim of committed denial audit when storage or audit capacity prevents that commit.

Profile/grant change and acceptance serialize through the same AuthDB transaction. Never acquire authenticator RLock from a held AuthDB connection or reauthenticate during a financial phase. Unrelated profile revision does not revoke unchanged identity; revocation tombstones remain permanent. H0 proves no cross-DB execution barrier.

proposed_api_boundaries: explicit fresh auth authority initializer; disabled ingress constructor does not create a DB
private authenticated-request core reused by existing authenticate and new ingress, not a second MAC/nonce implementation
accept exact immutable headers/method/target/body -> opaque local auth-only receipt after commit
inspect local auth-only handle -> passive immutable evidence; no import-from-JSON route
lookup original auth business CID under fresh signed current credit.read authorization; one nonce transaction
trusted offline exact grant/profile mutation with durable audit; no public admin bypass or new management listener

additional_h0_cases_not_run.case: legacy format1 authenticate positive and return contract after shared-core refactor
disabled ingress produces no database/marker/schema; existing missing/corrupt/unknown format never auto-created
new exact format reopen; old reader refusal; altered FK/PK/CHECK/triggers with same table/column names refuse
same-auth-transaction role/grant/input rejection consumes nonce plus denial; repeated nonce gives replay rather than replacement acceptance
auth COMMIT response loss, issuer restart, current credit.read original-CID lookup, immutable first acceptance and no successful execution handle
same CID different kind/payload conflicts; canonical equivalent amount refers to same payload; request hash remains exact raw signed bytes
original grant revoked; retry under a different active key/epoch cannot rebind original identity; current read and independent repay are separate grants
real competing profile/grant update and accept; receipt sequence/revision/epoch matches committed locked state
nonce expiry prunes only expired nonces strictly older than highwater, never original acceptance/reservation
reservation capacity, nonce capacity, audit inability and query under pressure all yield documented typed result without eviction or fake successful audit
unknown commit, rollback and private path/identity failure never issue a success handle; first raw outcome retained
cross issuer/account/tenant, forged/copy/JSON/thread/fork/restart handle denied before any future producer capability

validation_scope: All cases above remain NOT_RUN; pure Git/AST/model checks are not dynamic test evidence.
